meta.title: Make it clear
meta.source: Qwen3-ForcedAligner-0.6B word timings, regrouped into sentences

segments.en: Every lesson starts with a script.
segments.zh: 每节课都从一份脚本开始。

segments.en: Write for the ear: one idea per sentence.
segments.zh: 为耳朵写作：一句一个意思。

segments.en: The voice is synthesized, then every word is aligned.
segments.zh: 先合成配音，再对齐每一个词。

segments.en: Captions inherit those timestamps instead of guessing.
segments.zh: 字幕继承这些时间戳，而不是靠猜。

segments.en: Two lines, one idea, inside the safe area.
segments.zh: 两行，一个意思，放在安全区内。

segments.en: Then the cut: zooms, callouts, and an export.
segments.zh: 最后剪辑：缩放、批注，然后导出。
